concerns.text: The implementation plan (plan.md) explicitly requires a **DeLong’s test** for paired AUC comparison (see Phase 8), but task T013 (Efficiency & performance comparison) does not include this statistical test, only computes auc_diff and latency_ratio. Omitting DeLong’s test weakens the plan’s methodological requirement and leaves FR‑010/FR‑011 incompletely validated.
